subject: Food Science
title: Sous Vide Revolution
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Sous Vide Revolution.

hook.text: In 1974, French chef Georges Pralus cooked foie gras in a vacuum-sealed bag at precise temperatures.

buildup.text: Sous vide ('under vacuum') cooks food in sealed bags at exact temperatures for extended times.

discovery.text: Sous Vide Revolution reveals the mechanism or argument that changes the picture.

twist.text: Scientist Bruno Goussault was developing the same technique simultaneously for industrial food production.

climax.text: Sous Vide Revolution matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

quiz.question: What advantage does sous vide have over traditional cooking?
options: Temperature precision produces perfect doneness edge-to-edge with no gradient
